## source_to_kb

Task 1's `required_documents` are `rentals_ext_model_change_fee`, `rentals_ext_party_rate_charge` and
`rentals_ext_extension_charge`; the base policies governing their subjects are `rentals_pricing`,
`rentals_agg_party_pricing`, `rentals_swap_and_extension`, `rentals_fitting_and_pickup` and
`rentals_reservation_terms`. Each is covered in the full-domain table in `0.md §A/§B`; what follows
records the judgement for the three policies this task turns on, the whole of their domains.

### `rentals_ext_party_rate_charge` — baseline, five factors, two retirements

- **Baseline** → `hire_rate_computation_9fa8e4f9`. Every sentence of `baseline.rule` present: the
  length of the agreement (collection date through the date written, inclusive); the day rate as the
  package's shop day rate; the days charged for as the dates the account shows the kit out; all three
  "No … share is taken off"; the **sequential** order sentence ("the passholder share acts on the days
  charged for at the day rate, the bundle share acts on the amount the passholder step left, and the
  advance booking share acts on the amount the bundle step left; the three are never combined into one
  share"); rounding at the end of **each** of the three steps; add-ons forming no part of the hire
  rate. `baseline.params` (`daily_rate_usd`, `multi_day_daily_rate_usd`, `multi_day_threshold_days`,
  `weekly_rate_usd`, the four reduction percentages and `advance_booking_days_min`) are each named in
  words that reach `day_rate_and_lease_price_schedule_9ddd7bf5` and
  `standing_and_advance_reduction_schedule_21762eb0`. Nothing added.
- **`day_rate_basis`** (method) → `day_rate_selection_for_longer_agreements_87098a5d`. All three tiers
  with their compound conditions: seven days or more **and** the weekly rate lower than seven days at
  the multi-day rate → a seventh of the weekly rate, rounded half up to two decimal places (the
  rounding is in the source's `compute`, `RND(P('weekly_rate_usd') / 7, 2)`); at least the threshold
  and not such a block → the multi-day rate; otherwise → the shop day rate. The per-package table
  carries the threshold, the multi-day rate, the weekly rate **and** the "seven days at the multi-day
  day rate" column the comparison is made against (189/273/371/476/574/0), all exact.
- **`chargeable_day_basis`** (method) → `days_charged_for_on_an_agreement_29935120`. Three tiers: at
  least one date out **and** the kit out → the length of the agreement; kit set aside and not yet
  collected → the days written for; otherwise → the dates out. Its point of judgement insists the
  three counts are distinct.
- **`passholder_share_level`** → `passholder_share_on_the_hire_rate_ca88ea53`. Full / half / none,
  threshold **6** scans, three-month window running back from the day the hire rate is raised; the
  per-package share and its half (10/5, 15/7.5, 20/10, 20/10, 25/12.5, 30/15) all exact.
- **`bundle_share_level`** → `bundle_share_on_the_hire_rate_cd83ddc6`. **All four** combinations,
  "the two are never added together", per-package lesson/lodging/larger columns exact; the point of
  judgement fixes whose holding is whose (the school booking the rider's, the lodging the
  household's), matching `EXISTS('lessons'…)` / `EXISTS('lodging'…)`.
- **`advance_share_level`** → `advance_booking_share_on_the_hire_rate_c366b9e6`. Full / half / none;
  per-package period and threshold; both "exactly equal" edges stated.
- **Retirements 8 and 9** (`rentals_agg_party_pricing`'s passholder-per-rider clause and
  `rentals_pricing`'s advance-booking clause) are reproduced word for word and marked no longer in
  force in `party_booking_reduction_basis_3c820fca` §1 and `hire_rate_and_charge_basis_249b03fd`, each
  bounded ("The percentages themselves stand unchanged"; "Retirement reaches those two sentences and
  no further"). `rentals_agg_party_pricing` §§2–4 remain stated as rules in force.

## kb_to_source

Every normative claim in the documents this task reaches was traced to a source atom. The two checks
this layer exists for:

- **Cross-problem operational guidance:** none. `rental_extension_entry_9c5075c2` states its two
  prerequisite sentences under "When the charge is fixed" and nothing else about them — no tool, no
  policy, no performer, no "first do X". Its invocation block names only its own tool. A regex sweep
  over all 68 documents for routing language returned only the five prerequisite sentences on their
  own blocked sides.
- **A task's opening world state written in as a policy fact:** none. Nothing in the corpus says an
  agreement currently carries no hire rate, that a change stands unpriced, that a guest is in a
  Base Village Inn room, or that a pass shows any number of scans. A sweep for years, caller names,
  serials and identifiers returned nothing.

**Additions found: none.** No confirmation, review, notification or escalation the source does not
carry. `rental_extension_entry_9c5075c2`'s "What taking the extension does" paragraph is the tool's
own declared effect; `model_change_fee_entry_06531b2f`'s "The kit written on the agreement is not
touched by the raising of the fee, only the money owed for having changed it" and
`hire_rate_charge_entry_f7aaf673`'s "Add-ons the guest took are separate entries and form no part of
the hire rate" are the tool contract and the baseline rule respectively.

**Omissions found: none.** **Rewrites found: none** (the two candidates examined are recorded in
`0.md`, notes P5 and the `rentals_pricing` base-formula point; both are consequences of a declared
override or of source wording carried verbatim).

share, the half-helmet and half-extension-fee rows, the 0 % fitting-correction band and the 15 %

No previous revision of this file exists; this is revision 1. The policy-side notes P1–P7 recorded in

**The difficulty does not close out.** Two of the three parts pass on both tasks; the runtime part
fails on both.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | **KB-RUNTIME RED** | **PASS** | **PASS** |
| 1 | **KB-RUNTIME RED** | **PASS** | **PASS** |

- Audit files correspond one-to-one with the tasks: `runtime_context/equipment_rental_desk/{0,1}.md`
  and `policy_kb/equipment_rental_desk/{0,1}.md`. No earlier revision existed; these are revision 1,
  so nothing older has been overwritten. Each `blind_answer` was written to disk before any
  source-layer artefact was opened, and neither was altered after the reveal.
- Every normative atom of this difficulty's structured source is entailed by its product's docs, with
  nothing unborne, nothing borne with changed meaning and no claim from outside the source. All five
  prerequisite sentences stand verbatim, in the declared state form, in a document of the policy they
  block and in no other policy's; every hop is resolvable from the sentence, the depended-on documents
  and the records. All 35 declared factors' ladders are carried in full, every tier exact, findable
  from the records their tiers rest on. All ten retired base clauses are rendered as retired with the
  surviving clauses and figures still in force, and nothing is retired that the source does not
  declare. No other problem's tool name, route or aggregated chain is stated anywhere beyond those
  sentences and their same-form equivalents.
- **What blocks the close-out:** on both tasks the visible corpus admits two equally reasonable
  formulas for combining several shares and uplifts that "act on the base itself rather than on one
  another's results", and the branch derivable from the documents does not equal the source-layer
  solution for `late_fee_amount_usd` and `payment_amount_usd` (task 0) or `change_fee_amount_usd` and
  `extension_charge_usd` (task 1). The root cause is policy-side — the sentences are the source
  policies' own `baseline.rule` text carried verbatim, and it is each policy's own `compute` that
  disagrees with them — but a corpus that faithfully carries an underdetermined sentence is still a
  corpus a solver cannot close, so the runtime part cannot pass. Full evidence in
  `runtime_context/equipment_rental_desk/0.md § gt_comparison` and
  `runtime_context/equipment_rental_desk/1.md § gt_comparison`; root cause recorded as note P1 in
  `policy_kb/equipment_rental_desk/0.md § bijection_verdict`.
